name: How long does a garage remodeling project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a garage remodeling project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a garage remodeling project depends on its complexity and scale. A minor remodel, such as adding shelving, new flooring, or a fresh coat of paint, might be completed within 1-3 weeks. Converting a garage into a dedicated workspace or playroom, involving some electrical or insulation work, could take 4-8 weeks. Full garage conversions into an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) or a habitable room, which require permits, extensive structural changes, plumbing, and electrical work, can extend from 3 to 6 months, or even longer for complex designs. Unexpected issues or permit delays can also impact the schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Garage remodeling timelines vary. Minor remodels take 1-3 weeks, while complex conversions, like ADUs, can take 3-6 months or more, depending on scope and permits.
